run_parallel_threads: run a function across a list of arguments in parallel threads with a tqdm progress bar
run_parallel_processes: run a function across a list of arguments in parallel processes with a tqdm progress bar
test_parallel_threads_star_args: test parallel_threads with star_args to unpack tuple arguments into a function call
test_parallel_threads_kw_args: test parallel_threads with kw_args to unpack dictionary arguments into a function call
review_parallel_threads_front_num: review parallel_threads front_num parameter to run initial arguments sequentially before parallelizing the rest
